# What the macOS Apple Silicon bundle must have. One "kind name" per line.
#   configure / refuse-configure   an option FFmpeg is built with / must not be built with
#   decoder encoder demuxer muxer filter protocol bsf hwaccel   a name FFmpeg must list
#   option <where> <name>          an option that "ffmpeg -h <where>" must show
# The names come from what server-next calls and from the hardware the owner asked for.
# Against the Linux lists: the Mac's hardware path is Apple's VideoToolbox (decode, encode and
# its filters); VA-API, Quick Sync, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan do not exist on a Mac. libplacebo needs
# Vulkan, so it is left out as upstream leaves it out on macOS (the owner's choice, 18 Nov design
# question 2): Dolby Vision and HDR are tone mapped by tonemapx, zscale, VideoToolbox or OpenCL.

refuse-configure --enable-nonfree
refuse-configure --enable-libfdk-aac

# Libraries
configure --enable-libass
configure --enable-fontconfig
configure --enable-libfreetype
configure --enable-libfribidi
configure --enable-libharfbuzz
configure --enable-libbluray
configure --enable-libdvdnav

configure --enable-libsoxr

# Hardware
configure --enable-videotoolbox

configure --enable-opencl
